art_note: High-end lifestyle and studio imagery that captures the sleek silhouette and athletic aesthetic effectively.
desc_en: Redefine your training with a sculpted silhouette that combines precision and absolute freedom. This one-piece design features a short front zip, a structured high neck, and a striking open back. The flexible fabric adapts to every movement with absolute lightness. Designed for high-intensity sessions or an impeccable urban aesthetic. An essential garment for those who demand performance without compromising technical elegance.
desc_es: Redefine tu entrenamiento con una silueta esculpida que combina precisión y libertad absoluta. Este diseño de una sola pieza presenta una cremallera frontal corta, un cuello alto estructurado y una llamativa espalda abierta. El tejido flexible se adapta a cada movimiento con total ligereza. Pensado para sesiones de alta intensidad o para un estilo urbano impecable. Una prenda esencial para quienes exigen rendimiento sin renunciar a la elegancia técnica.
details_en:
· Composition: 80% polyester and 20% elastane
· Lightweight, breathable, and flexible fabric
· Short front zipper and high neck

· Chest logo and printed text on the back waist

· Made to order and worldwide shipping
